column3: MT 12:33. “On their mouth” is rendered “at their command.”
MT 12:34. “With not a heart and a heart” is rendered “with an undivided heart,” and NASB supplies “David.”
MT 12:39. “Complete heart” is rendered “perfect heart,” and “one heart” as “one mind.”
MT 12:41. NASB adds “even as far as” and “great quantities.”
